name: Harvey
source:
A mild-mannered angel residing in room 202. She's a bookworm, and is hesitant when asked anything about the angelic teachings or the other angels.

[spoiler]Her real name is Miria Kusunoki. She was pressured by [url=https://vndb.org/c101159]Mother[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c83874]Sally[/url] to keep the other tenants in-line with the rules of the 'family,' and fearing for her own life, was forced to obey.[/spoiler]
